# Pillars and indicators {#sec-pillars} The framework groups indicators into two families — **exposure & susceptibility** (what raises risk) and **agency-resilience** (what protects it) — following the logic introduced in @sec-resilience. > Risk is read as **Exposure × Susceptibility ÷ Agency-Resilience**. Every indicator is defined once, in the machine-readable registry at `analysis/registry/indicators.yml`, which drives both the computation (@sec-constructing) and the codebook (see the appendix).
